itinerary.title: 3-day cultural weekend: Delhi → Jaipur (Pink City)
itinerary.summary: A relaxed, cultural 3-day trip for 2 adults by train: forts, palaces, museums and local markets, staying in a mid-range heritage hotel in central Jaipur. All meals vegetarian (pure-veg options). Weather: dry, warm days (~27°C), cool mornings (~15°C).

outbound.description: Estimated daytime intercity/express (AC chair/AC 2-tier option). Depart Delhi in the morning, arrive Jaipur same day — leaves early to allow a full first day of sightseeing.

return.description: Evening intercity/express from Jaipur to Delhi on 2026-11-16, arrive same night.

transport.local: Pre-booked taxi for airport/station transfers + taxi/auto-rickshaw rides or app-based cabs for intra-city sightseeing (group hires for half-day sightseeing recommended).

accommodation.name: Devi Niketan Heritage Hotel (or similar mid-range heritage hotel, central/Pink City area)
accommodation.area: Pink City / MI Road area (central, walkable to markets)
accommodation.why: Central location for quick access to City Palace, Hawa Mahal and markets; heritage character that fits cultural trip style; mid-range price with likely breakfast included.

days.weather: Mostly dry; high ~27°C, low ~16°C — comfortable for walking.

activities.name: City Palace (guided walk)
activities.description: Explore the courtyards, palace museum and royal collections — a core heritage stop that gives history of Jaipur's ruling family and architecture.

activities.name: Jantar Mantar
activities.description: Visit the historic astronomical observatory — quick and fascinating outdoor/indoor displays.

activities.name: Johari / Bapu Bazaar (Pink City market walk + light shopping)
activities.description: Stroll the Pink City bazaars for textiles, jewelry, lacwork and traditional crafts — cultural shopping and photography.

meals.place: Doodh Misthan Bhandar (DMR) or similar pure-veg restaurant

days.notes: Check in on arrival (approx late morning). Keep a water bottle and hat — November days are warm but mornings can be cool.

days.weather: Mostly dry; high ~27°C — great day for forts and gardens.

activities.name: Amer (Amber) Fort & Sheesh Mahal
activities.description: Full morning at Amer Fort: ramparts, palace halls and Sheesh Mahal (mirror palace). Arrive early to avoid crowds and midday heat.

activities.name: Panna Meena Ka Kund (stepwell)
activities.description: Short visit to this nearby historic stepwell — good for photos and local architecture appreciation.

activities.name: Albert Hall Museum
activities.description: Visit Jaipur's state museum with art, textiles and regional artifacts — indoor and culturally rich.

meals.place: Chokhi Dhani (Tonk Road) or similar Rajasthani pure-veg option
Green Restaurant Pure Vegetarian or similar

days.notes: Start early for Amer Fort. Wear comfortable shoes for steps and uneven surfaces. Bring sunscreen and water.

days.theme: Viewpoints, gardens & local market — return to Delhi
days.weather: Mostly dry; high ~27°C — pleasant for morning viewpoint and garden visit.

activities.name: Nahargarh Fort viewpoint (morning visit)
activities.description: Panoramic views over Jaipur from Nahargarh; morning light is great for photos and a relaxed walk.

activities.name: Sisodiya Rani Bagh (garden/palace)
activities.description: Visit the landscaped garden and palatial pavilions built for the queen — quieter and scenic.

activities.name: Bapu / Nehru Bazaar market walk & small purchases
activities.description: Final market stroll for textiles, block-printed fabrics and handicrafts; cultural shopping and street photography.

meals.place: Local pure-veg restaurant near markets (e.g., Roop Basant Pavitra Bhojanalaya or similar)
On train (return) / light dinner at station (vegetarian)

days.notes: Check out mid-afternoon, keep luggage at hotel if needed, then transfer to station for evening train to Delhi.

packingTips: Light layers for cool mornings and warm afternoons (Nov: ~15–27°C).
Comfortable walking shoes for forts, markets and uneven surfaces.
Reusable water bottle (refillable) — stay hydrated while sightseeing.
tips: Book train seats early (book AC chair/2A return) to secure preferred timings.
Carry small cash for markets; many shops prefer UPI but small vendors may take only cash.
All meals planned are vegetarian; confirm 'pure-veg' at restaurants when you arrive.
Start early at Amer Fort and Nahargarh for cooler temperatures and fewer crowds.
Negotiate taxi fares for half-day hires or use app-based cabs with day-packages for convenience.
